title: Peakmart Order Event order.placed
description: An Order Event of type `order.placed` as Peakmart publishes it on its topic `peakmart.orders.v2` (UC-002). Peakmart owns this format and may add fields without notice (C-006), so extra fields are allowed. The schema says what can be read as a Peakmart Order (UC-002 A2); the Order Checks are not part of it (UC-003 BR-010).

event_type.description: Type of the Order Event. Events of any other type are skipped before they are read, UC-002 BR-001.

event_id.description: Event id of the Order Event, a UUID in the sample. Not the Duplicate key: the same Order may arrive under a new event id, UC-002 BR-002.

occurred_at.description: Date and time of the event, with its offset; the sample uses UTC (`Z`). Taken as the time the Customer placed the Order (UC-002 BR-008).

order_ref.description: Order Number. `PM-` and digits is an Order Check, UC-003 BR-002. Checked against the Orders already received, UC-002 BR-002.

email.description: Email address of the Customer; an Order Event whose email is not an email address cannot be read and is set aside (UC-002 BR-009). Personal data (C-021).

ship_to.description: Shipping Address. Its parts are not required here: a missing part is a Rejection Reason, UC-003 BR-007. Personal data (C-021).

address2.description: Second address line, when there is one.

country_code.description: Country code; the US or Canada is an Order Check, UC-003 BR-008.

items.description: Order Lines. Their number, 1 to 30, is an Order Check, UC-003 BR-005.

sku.description: SKU of the Product. Checked against the Product Catalog, UC-003 BR-009.

qty.description: Number of items. 1 to 20 is an Order Check, UC-003 BR-006.

price_usd.description: Peakmart Price of one item, a string in US dollars with two decimals (C-006).
